posts.name: jagarciao
posts.cooked:
But it would also be logical and within reason to have the H reduced since H is defined in the rules as the "current" number of players... but we have been told that H is, in fact, not reduced when a player leaves the game for some reason. 

So, while logic is indeed on your side, we can't really rely on logic to dictate rulings anymore. 

 

I have to admit that all this ambiguous wordings and sometimes counterintuitive or even contradictory situations has been taking away from the game a little bit for me. I do love the game and have a group of people I play with where we don't have a problem because we have such a laid attitude about how things work and we tweak them freely as necessary... but I have often had a hard time explaining (or defending) certain card interactions when trying to bring the game to new players... to the point that I tend to avoid it and just stick to playing with my group only.
